name: code-search-fleet
description: One search interface over a fleet of repositories, backed by whichever engine can actually answer the question

plugins.name: code-search
plugins.description: Search across many repositories at once — who calls an endpoint, where a symbol is defined, what implements an interface, which repo publishes a package, and when a cross-repo seam last changed. Routes each question to whichever of five engines can answer it, and labels every answer with the kind of evidence behind it.
